mapper.select: select min(date(publish_time)) as startTime , max(date(publish_time)) as endTime from ays_api_reslt_data
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ays_api_reslt_data_analysis where client_id = #{clientId} and channel_id = #{channelId} and date(publish_time) BETWEEN DATE(#{startTime}) and DATE(#{endTime})

with find_1 as ( select id, work_id from ays_api_reslt_data_analysis group by id,work_id limit 1 ) select new_id from ays_api_reslt_data_analysis as f, find_1 as c where c.work_id = f.work_id limit 100
mapper.delete: delete from ays_api_reslt_data_analysis_valid where to_date(publish_time) <= to_date(DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL ${days} day))
